title: rcf guidance, the bundle runbook and the overview state the twelve rules and test strength as a report

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] `rcf guidance build-cycle` and the MCP resource `rcf://docs/build-cycle` each state the twelve rules as one list numbered 1 to 12, read as AC-20503-1 reads them (rule 3 under ruling R0 E1, rules 5 and 6 verbatim); the DEFINE section's exit reads "Each new test is red at the DEFINE head with its failing assertion recorded, and the suite fails on exactly the new tests. No throwaway."; the FINALISE section says Finalise requires the test-strength record and never refuses on its result. No document `rcf guidance` serves (every topic of `rcf guidance --list`, every `rcf://docs/` resource) and no runbook `rcf build bundle` prints (md, and json `completionContract`) contains "proven red for the right reason".

[happy] The runbook `rcf build bundle <fbs> --base-suite <green>` prints, in `--format md` and in the `--format json` `completionContract`, gives the DEFINE stage the rule 6 text ("Each new test is red at the DEFINE head with its failing assertion recorded, and the suite fails on exactly the new tests.", with no throwaway) and the REVIEW stage the line that test strength is recorded for the reviewer's adequacy verdict.

[happy] `rcf guidance overview` keeps "The tool referees structure, never adequacy." word for word, and one sentence says that a gutted test is shown by the test-strength report ("the test-strength report shows it") and that the reviewer judges it.
